sections.heading: Care Built Around Each Patient
text: At Cambridge Hospital, our care model is built around one principle: recovery is not a single event, but a continuous journey. Every patient’s needs are different, and those needs can change as they progress through recovery. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with patients and their families to understand these needs and provide the right level of medical care, rehabilitation, therapy and ongoing support at each stage.

We care for patients with complex medical conditions, neurological injuries, paediatric needs, ventilator requirements and long-term care needs through structured programmes designed to restore function, build independence and improve quality of life. Our connected services span inpatient rehabilitation, outpatient care, home healthcare and in-school care, allowing patients to move between different levels and settings of care as their needs evolve. From the close medical supervision and intensive therapy needed during inpatient rehabilitation, to specialist outpatient treatment and therapy, and continued care and rehabilitation at home, our approach helps patients maintain their progress and apply their gains in everyday life.

By bringing these services together within one connected system of care, we can provide continuity throughout the recovery journey, while giving patients and families the support and guidance they need along the way.
